up: Return the public ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for distinct molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1139796. Only include rows where a canonical SMILES is available. Order the results by the ChEMBL identifier, then compound name, then canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cr.compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1139796'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
